verification_method: Every entry below was confirmed by sending an UNPAID request to the live paid route, capturing the HTTP 402 `payment-required` header, base64-decoding it, and reading accepts[].payTo / accepts[].amount on 2026-11-22. Manifests can lie; the live challenge is the source of truth.
matching_rule: payTo must match canonical_payto case-INSENSITIVELY (EVM addresses are hex; do not string-compare). Anything else is NOT RAEN.

reject.retired_note: RETIRED wallet. Some stale directory/trust records (including Lumi/Bazaar caches) still carry it or lookalikes. Funds sent here are misrouted.
reject.rule: Verify every address character-by-character against canonical_payto, never by prefix or suffix shorthand.

machine_verification_recipe: 2. Send your unpaid request to the paid route; expect HTTP 402 with a `payment-required` header.
3. base64-decode that header; read accepts[].payTo and accepts[].amount.
4. Accept ONLY if payTo equals canonical_payto (case-insensitive) AND amount matches this registry for that service.
5. Reject any challenge naming the retired wallet, a lookalike address, or a different chain/asset.
